subject: general
question: If tan θ + cot θ = 21, then find the value of 6 tan² θ + 6 cot² θ.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **tan θ + cot θ = k**, then **tan² θ + cot² θ = k² − 2**.

Given **k = 21**, so **tan² θ + cot² θ = 21² − 2 = 441 − 2 = 439**.

Value required = **6 × (tan² θ + cot² θ) = 6 × 439**.

**⇒ 2634**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2634.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** tan θ + cot θ = 21

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and tan θ × cot θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a0a7af71f9dc7579ed80ac2e59ae840c5d0ee7c8a6342b02cb8b6282226cf9.png] 

⇒ (tan θ + cot θ)² = 21²

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ + 2(tan θ × cot θ) = 441

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ + 2(1) = 441

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ = 441 − 2 = 439

⇒ Required value = 6(tan² θ + cot² θ)

⇒ 6 × 439 = 2634

**∴ The correct answer is 2634.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

tan θ and cot θ are reciprocals of each other, hence tan θ × cot θ = 1.

Pythagorean Identities

sec² θ − tan² θ = 1 and cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Algebraic Shortcut

If x + 1/x = n, then x² + 1/x² = n² − 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = n³ − 3n.</p
